name: Dust Boom
description: Speculators flood the markets. +20% Dust for five turns.

name: Solar Flares
description: Instruments across the empire are blinded by stellar activity. -15% science for four turns.

name: Bumper Harvest
description: A perfect season on every farming world. +20% food for four turns.

name: Labour Unrest
description: Strikes spread from system to system. -10 approval for four turns.

name: Spore Plague
description: A fungal blight crosses the lanes. -15% food and -30% growth for five turns.

name: Galactic Trade Fair
description: Merchants and envoys converge on your worlds. +10% Dust and +2 influence per system for four turns.

name: Breakthrough
description: A junior researcher asks the right question. +25% science for three turns.

name: Meteor Shower
description: Orbital works shut down while the sky falls. -10% industry for three turns.
